messages.subject: Individual level covariates
parts:
Hi all,
  Based on the way we structure data for time removal counts, it would appear that we cannot have covariates associated with individual birds (we were hoping to use distance as a covariate in a time-removal analysis).  Does that sound correct?

Thanks!

Andrew
